questions.prompt: Which boundary should own the durable result?

feedback.correct: The authoritative service owns durable truth.

incorrectByOptionId.screen: A screen cannot be the durable owner.
incorrectByOptionId.cache: An unverified cache cannot establish durable truth.

questions.prompt: Select every measure that makes a retry safe and observable.
constraints: There can be more than one correct option.
Do not select an unsafe fallback.

feedback.correct: Safe retries need identity, a bounded policy, and a visible repair path.

incorrectByOptionId.silent-loop: An unbounded silent loop hides failure and can duplicate work.

omittedByOptionId.idempotency: Without identity, a retry can duplicate the operation.
omittedByOptionId.bounded-retry: A retry needs an explicit limit and classification.
omittedByOptionId.repair-state: Users need a visible path when recovery is unavailable.

questions.prompt: Put the recovery steps in the order that preserves the user's intent.
constraints: Every element must appear exactly once.
The sequence must expose failure before claiming success.

feedback.correct: Evidence and intent are preserved before the repair outcome is confirmed.

incorrectByElementId.observe: Start by observing the boundary that failed.
incorrectByElementId.preserve: Preserve repairable intent before changing state.
incorrectByElementId.expose: Expose unavailable or partial state instead of masking it.
incorrectByElementId.recover: Confirm the resulting state after recovery.

brokenByRelationId.observe->preserve: Observation must precede preservation of intent.
brokenByRelationId.preserve->expose: The user intent must be safe before the unavailable state is exposed.
brokenByRelationId.expose->recover: Recovery should follow an explicit unavailable state.

questions.prompt: Select the tightest complexity for a single linear scan using constant working state.
constraints: No collection grows with the input.

feedback.correct: One scan is linear and constant working state is constant auxiliary space.

incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.time|constant: The scan must inspect the input, so constant time is too small.
incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.time|quadratic: A single scan does not perform quadratic work.
incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.auxiliary-space|linear: The algorithm retains only constant working state.

omittedByDimensionId.time: A time choice is required to score the dimension.
omittedByDimensionId.auxiliary-space: An auxiliary-space choice is required to score the dimension.

questions.prompt: Choose the design decision for each independent boundary.
constraints: Choose one value for every dimension.
Keep authority and failure behavior explicit.

values.text: Enforce the result at the trusted service
Hide the control in the client
Allow the action when policy is unknown

feedback.correct: The trusted boundary owns enforcement and exposes a repairable failure.

incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.authority|hidden-control: Hiding a control is not authorization.
incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.authority|client-check: A client check is not a trusted enforcement boundary.
incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.failure|silent-retry: Silent retries conceal the failure and have no repair budget.
incorrectByDimensionIdAndValueId.failure|fail-open: Unknown policy must not allow the protected action.

omittedByDimensionId.authority: The enforcement owner must be explicit.
omittedByDimensionId.failure: The unavailable or denied state must have a repair behavior.
